"""Rule-heavy end-to-end run through the bounded child (output size / timing)."""
import json, random, sys, tempfile, time
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/dev')
import public_check
root = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='e2e3-', dir='/workspace/tmp'))
frozen = root/'submission'; public_check.freeze(Path('/workspace/submission'), frozen)

rng = random.Random(17)
fields = [{'name':f'f{i}','type':['time','size','count','id','flag'][i%5],'domain':[0,1]} for i in range(16)]
preds = []
for i in range(32):
    refs = rng.sample([[0, f['name']] for f in fields], 4)
    preds.append({'kind':'cmp','left':{'sum':refs},'op':'ge','right':{'const':1,'type':'count'}})
train = [[[rng.choice([0,1]) for _ in range(16)]] for _ in range(2000)]
queries = [{'target':[0,'f0'],'prefix':'','fixed':[]},
           {'target':[0,'f1'],'prefix':'1','fixed':[{'ref':[0,'f2'],'value':1}]}]
job = {'fields':fields,'slots':1,'predicates':preds,'width':4,'train':train,
       'approved':[sorted(rng.sample(range(32),rng.randint(1,4))) for _ in range(256)],'queries':queries}
data = json.dumps({'jobs':[job]}).encode()
cwd = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='case-', dir=root))
t=time.time(); out = public_check.capture(frozen/'main.py', data, cwd); dt=time.time()-t
res = out['results'][0]
blob = json.dumps(out)
print('child wall %.2fs rules=%d active=%d output=%.2fMiB' % (dt, len(res['rules']), len(res['active']), len(blob)/1048576))
import collections
print('rule lengths', collections.Counter(len(r['clause']) for r in res['rules']))
print('answers', res['answers'])
import shutil; shutil.rmtree(root, ignore_errors=True)
PYEOF
